fusions.name: Shed Coat Flurry
fusions.desc: Flings shed fur in a cone 4 tiles long that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Blunted] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Plucked Tuft
fusions.desc: Throws a tuft of plucked strands that deals 14 damage and stuns the target for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Downy Layer
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 6 seconds, raises your armour by 5%, and you move 15% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed in Passing
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 5. At 5 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack, 35% at full. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
